يجتمر (form VIII)
# يَجْتَمِرُ (yajtamiru) /jad͡ʒ.ta.mi.ru/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِجْتَمَرَ (ijtamara)
# يُجْتَمَرُ (yujtamaru) /jud͡ʒ.ta.ma.ru/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِجْتَمَرَ (ijtamara)
# يَجْتَمِرَ (yajtamira) /jad͡ʒ.ta.mi.ra/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِجْتَمَرَ (ijtamara)
